purpose: Evergreen identity system for LuHm-OS, Pirate Daddies Film, original interactive characters and artist-first media that survives future hardware, providers and features without serial rebranding.

studio.renameRule: Legacy title spelling remains evidence; current approved registry display is authoritative pending explicit conflict reconciliation.

world.rule: World story identity does not rename software or publisher.

typography.licenseRule: self-host only licensed distributable fonts; no presumed proprietary font rights
typography.tone: retro-future cathedral + cyber-goth, readable at phone size

sizing.appIcon: adaptive Android raster variants after art approval
sizing.safeArea: preserve caption-safe areas and logo clear space

rules: recognizable silhouette from 32px app icons to 4K trailers
no arbitrary rainbow theme forks or profile-specific names
visual theme may adapt platform but never change canonical name
no third-party vendor badges or logos without independent permission
accessibility contrast and text size must be tested before release

extensionLaw.newHardware: new vendor adapter/profile; reuse same product lockup and icon
extensionLaw.newFeature: new registered widget family or slot under luhmOs; no core rebrand
extensionLaw.newPlatform: responsive theme token profile and export receipt, no master rename
extensionLaw.newMediaSeries: campaign skin inherits studio publisher and master title lockup
extensionLaw.majorRebrandRequires: separate Professor decision + alias/migration plan, never implied by a UI tweak
extensionLaw.brandVersioning: MAJOR for intentional identity change, MINOR for approved family additions, PATCH for nonsemantic export/cropping corrections
